CVE-1999-0001.summary: ip_input.c in BSD-derived TCP/IP implementations allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (crash or hang) via crafted packets.

CVE-1999-0003.summary: Execute commands as root via buffer overflow in Tooltalk database server (rpc.ttdbserverd).

CVE-1999-0004.summary: MIME buffer overflow in email clients, e.g. Solaris mailtool and Outlook.

CVE-1999-0005.summary: Arbitrary command execution via IMAP buffer overflow in authenticate command.

CVE-1999-0007.summary: Information from SSL-encrypted sessions via PKCS #1.

CVE-1999-0019.summary: Delete or create a file via rpc.statd, due to invalid information.

CVE-1999-0027.summary: root privileges via buffer overflow in eject command on SGI IRIX systems.

CVE-1999-0028.summary: root privileges via buffer overflow in login/scheme command on SGI IRIX systems.

CVE-1999-0046.summary: Buffer overflow of rlogin program using TERM environmental variable.

CVE-1999-0067.summary: phf CGI program allows remote command execution through shell metacharacters.

CVE-1999-0070.summary: test-cgi program allows an attacker to list files on the server.

CVE-1999-0082.summary: CWD ~root command in ftpd allows root access.

CVE-1999-0084.summary: Certain NFS servers allow users to use mknod to gain privileges by creating a writable kmem device and setting the UID to 0.

CVE-1999-0095.summary: The debug command in Sendmail is enabled, allowing attackers to execute commands as root.

CVE-1999-0101.summary: Buffer overflow in AIX and Solaris "gethostbyname" library call allows root access through corrupt DNS host names.

CVE-1999-0103.summary: Echo and chargen, or other combinations of UDP services, can be used in tandem to flood the server, a.k.a. UDP bomb or UDP packet storm.

CVE-1999-0107.summary: Buffer overflow in Apache 1.2.5 and earlier allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service with a large number of GET requests containing a large number of / characters.

CVE-1999-0130.summary: Local users can start Sendmail in daemon mode and gain root privileges.

CVE-1999-0154.summary: IIS 2.0 and 3.0 allows remote attackers to read the source code for ASP pages by appending a . (dot) to the end of the URL.

CVE-1999-0170.summary: Remote attackers can mount an NFS file system in Ultrix or OSF, even if it is denied on the access list.

CVE-1999-0174.summary: The view-source CGI program allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) attack.

CVE-1999-0182.summary: Samba has a buffer overflow which allows a remote attacker to obtain root access by specifying a long password.

CVE-1999-0192.summary: Buffer overflow in telnet daemon tgetent routing allows remote attackers to gain root access via the TERMCAP environmental variable.

CVE-1999-0199.summary: manual/search.texi in the GNU C Library (aka glibc) before 2.2 lacks a statement about the unspecified tdelete return value upon deletion of a tree's root, which might allow attackers to access a dangling pointer in an application whose developer was unaware of a documentation update from 1999.

CVE-1999-0201.summary: A quote cwd command on FTP servers can reveal the full path of the home directory of the "ftp" user.

CVE-1999-0204.summary: Sendmail 8.6.9 allows remote attackers to execute root commands, using ident.

CVE-1999-0206.summary: MIME buffer overflow in Sendmail 8.8.0 and 8.8.1 gives root access.

CVE-1999-0209.summary: The SunView (SunTools) selection_svc facility allows remote users to read files.

CVE-1999-0210.summary: Automount daemon automountd allows local or remote users to gain privileges via shell metacharacters.

CVE-1999-0211.summary: Extra long export lists over 256 characters in some mount daemons allows NFS directories to be mounted by anyone.

CVE-1999-0236.summary: ScriptAlias directory in NCSA and Apache httpd allowed attackers to read CGI programs.

CVE-1999-0242.summary: Remote attackers can access mail files via POP3 in some Linux systems that are using shadow passwords.

CVE-1999-0244.summary: Livingston RADIUS code has a buffer overflow which can allow remote execution of commands as root.

CVE-1999-0245.summary: Some configurations of NIS+ in Linux allowed attackers to log in as the user "+".

CVE-1999-0248.summary: A race condition in the authentication agent mechanism of sshd 1.2.17 allows an attacker to steal another user's credentials.

CVE-1999-0249.summary: Windows NT RSHSVC program allows remote users to execute arbitrary commands.

CVE-1999-0250.summary: Denial of service in Qmail through long SMTP commands.

CVE-1999-0252.summary: Buffer overflow in listserv allows arbitrary command execution.

CVE-1999-0256.summary: Buffer overflow in War FTP allows remote execution of commands.

CVE-1999-0259.summary: cfingerd lists all users on a system via search.**@target.

CVE-1999-0265.summary: ICMP redirect messages may crash or lock up a host.

CVE-1999-0266.summary: The info2www CGI script allows remote file access or remote command execution.

CVE-1999-0267.summary: Buffer overflow in NCSA HTTP daemon v1.3 allows remote command execution.

CVE-1999-0268.summary: MetaInfo MetaWeb web server allows users to upload, execute, and read scripts.

CVE-1999-0269.summary: Netscape Enterprise servers may list files through the PageServices query.

CVE-1999-0281.summary: Denial of service in IIS using long URLs.

CVE-1999-0285.summary: Denial of service in telnet from the Windows NT Resource Kit, by opening then immediately closing a connection.

CVE-1999-0372.summary: The installer for BackOffice Server includes account names and passwords in a setup file (reboot.ini) which is not deleted.

CVE-1999-0391.summary: The cryptographic challenge of SMB authentication in Windows 95 and Windows 98 can be reused, allowing an attacker to replay the response and impersonate a user.

CVE-1999-0407.summary: By default, IIS 4.0 has a virtual directory /IISADMPWD which contains files that can be used as proxies for brute force password attacks, or to identify valid users on the system.

CVE-1999-0412.summary: In IIS and other web servers, an attacker can attack commands as SYSTEM if the server is running as SYSTEM and loading an ISAPI extension.

CVE-1999-0426.summary: The default permissions of /dev/kmem in Linux versions before 2.0.36 allows IP spoofing.

CVE-1999-0428.summary: OpenSSL and SSLeay allow remote attackers to reuse SSL sessions and bypass access controls.

CVE-1999-0454.summary: A remote attacker can sometimes identify the operating system of a host based on how it reacts to some IP or ICMP packets, using a tool such as nmap or queso.

CVE-1999-0502.summary: A Unix account has a default, null, blank, or missing password.

CVE-1999-0509.summary: Perl, sh, csh, or other shell interpreters are installed in the cgi-bin directory on a WWW site, which allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.

CVE-1999-0511.summary: IP forwarding is enabled on a machine which is not a router or firewall.

CVE-1999-0512.summary: A mail server is explicitly configured to allow SMTP mail relay, which allows abuse by spammers.

CVE-1999-0517.summary: An SNMP community name is the default (e.g. public), null, or missing.

CVE-1999-0519.summary: A NETBIOS/SMB share password is the default, null, or missing.

CVE-1999-0524.summary: ICMP information such as (1) netmask and (2) timestamp is allowed from arbitrary hosts.

CVE-1999-0526.summary: An X server's access control is disabled (e.g. through an "xhost +" command) and allows anyone to connect to the server.

CVE-1999-0532.summary: A DNS server allows zone transfers.

CVE-1999-0612.summary: A version of finger is running that exposes valid user information to any entity on the network.

CVE-1999-0789.summary: Buffer overflow in AIX ftpd in the libc library.

CVE-1999-0867.summary: Denial of service in IIS 4.0 via a flood of HTTP requests with malformed headers.

CVE-1999-0898.summary: Buffer overflows in Windows NT 4.0 print spooler allow remote attackers to gain privileges or cause a denial of service via a malformed spooler request.

CVE-1999-0906.summary: Buffer overflow in sccw allows local users to gain root access via the HOME environmental variable.

CVE-1999-0910.summary: Microsoft Site Server and Commercial Internet System (MCIS) do not set an expiration for a cookie, which could then be cached by a proxy and inadvertently used by a different user.

CVE-1999-0918.summary: Denial of service in various Windows systems via malformed, fragmented IGMP packets.

CVE-1999-1177.summary: Directory traversal vulnerability in nph-publish before 1.2 allows remote attackers to overwrite arbitrary files via a .. (dot dot) in the pathname for an upload operation.
